report.score_method: Sample health is the weighted average of completed checks: links & resources 40%, content & discoverability 25%, document accessibility 20%, delivery & transport 15%. Link/resource responses and title/viewport/HTTPS checks count double within their category. Unknown checks are excluded. Confirmed missing pages or resources cap the final score at 74 (grade C), so healthy metadata cannot hide broken paths. A ≥90, B ≥75, C ≥60, D ≥40, F <40. This is a document-and-response heuristic, not a security, SEO or accessibility certification.
